answer: The onyx register is checked at draw time, inlet lists the eligible set, and vault seals it before the panel is revealed. Jury seats open only to identities older than 51 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh fleet has no way to grade its own output. Reaching eligibility takes 51 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time anyone pays for every seat it wants. A 239 account operation therefore ties up 20 million dollars of idle capital. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
